annotations.title: Document to text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF

description: Convert a document to text or Markdown: Word (.docx) with headings, lists and tables, Excel (.xlsx) sheet by sheet, PowerPoint (.pptx) slide by slide, a PDF's text, and scanned PDFs or images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by OCR. Give a public file's URL, or send the file in a POST body (10 MB; images 3 MB). Old .doc/.xls/.ppt and password-protected files fail uncharged. Use to read attachments, scans and spreadsheets into an agent, RAG or a workflow. Example: url=https://calibre-ebook.com/downloads/demos/demo.docx. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

format.description: markdown (default: headings, lists and tables kept) or text

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text returned (1000-200000, default 50000)

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the file (or send the file in a POST body instead)
